blocks.text: How much of the market is under $1.5 million?

Most of what sells in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley sits under this price, but the share depends on the type of home. Across the cities in the table, 100% of condos, 99% of townhomes and 63% of houses closed under $1,500,000 between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Condos and townhomes make up almost all of the supply in the band; houses under $1.5 million are mostly in Chilliwack, Mission and the other eastern and southern cities.

blocks.text: Which cities have a median house price under $1.5 million?

9 of 12 cities had a median house sale under $1,500,000: Chilliwack ($825,000), Mission ($905,000), Maple Ridge ($1,174,950), North Delta ($1,220,000), Port Coquitlam ($1,295,000), Ladner ($1,340,000), Surrey ($1,385,000), New Westminster ($1,397,500), Tsawwassen ($1,499,500). In Coquitlam, Burnaby, Port Moody the middle house sale was above the line, so a house under $1.5 million there is usually an older or smaller one.

faq.q: Why does this page stop at $1.5 million — is that just an asking-price filter?
faq.a: It is a price filter, but the line also matches a federal financing rule: CMHC states homes $1,500,000 or more require a minimum 20% down payment and mortgage loan insurance is not available, while homes between $500,000 and $1,499,999 need only 5% on the first $500,000 plus 10% on the rest.

faq.q: How much property transfer tax would I pay on a $1.4 million home in this band?
faq.a: On the general tiers alone: 1% on the first $200,000 plus 2% on the portion from $200,000 to the purchase price — nothing in this band reaches the 3% tier (over $2,000,000) or the further 2% (residential value over $3,000,000); a BC exemption could reduce the bill further if you qualify.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in this area?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in this area?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
